summary: Nyxoah SA filed a Form 6-K containing its interim financial statements and management discussion for the six months ended June 30, 2026. The filing reports routine operational results for the surgical and medical instruments company and includes details on its financing arrangements with the European Investment Bank, including a synthetic warrant agreement, convertible bonds, and loan facilities. No special-situation event is described. This is an ordinary periodic report, not a transaction announcement, corporate action, or structural reorganization.
